title: Vishnu Puranam - 04 - Dhruva Charithram
author: Vishnu Sreenivas
excerpt:
Today we see Dhruva Charithram.

Dhruva was a prince who came in the lineage of Swayambuva Manu. Dhruva's father's name was Uttanapada. Uttanapada had two wives named Suneeti and Suruchi. Suneeti's son was Dhruva, and Suruchi's son was named Uttama. Suneeti was a very pious lady whereas, Suruchi was only interested in worldly pleasures. One day, when Dhruva was running five years of age, he noticed his step-brother sitting on his father's lap and wished to also sit on his father's lap as well.
